desc:
Sanity is a horror experience. Some things are better left undiscovered.

📖 [ABOUT] When your brother mysteriously disappears during a camping trip, what begins as a simple investigation quickly spirals into something far more sinister. Venture deep into a abandoned facility and discover what lies beneath the surface.

⚠️ [WARNING] This experience contains flashing lights, loud noises, fear, jumpscares. 

⚙️ [RECOMMENDED]
+ Use headphones for the best experience.
+ Graphics setting 6+ 
+ High Brightness on your device.
+ Flashlight brightness CAN be modified with in-game settings

💻 [COMPATIBILITY]
+ PC
+ Mobile & Tablet
+ Console
+ 1-6 Player Lobbies

[KEYBINDS]
P - Settings

Join the ROBLOX group for info about future chapters!
https://www.roblox.com/communities/12851441/Revertable#!/about
